transmission_hypothesis: Higher preliminary server vendor revenue may support an indirect demand hypothesis for some upstream chips only if corroborated by supplier orders, actual shipments and cash conversion. It does not imply SOXX constituents gained revenue or SOXX price rose on October 20.

One downstream AI-server integrator cannot establish broad semiconductor orders or shipment growth.
Higher revenue can reflect timing, backlog conversion, product mix or competitive shifts, not necessarily new chip bookings.
